label: Yogi Bear
description: Smarter than the average bear, and scouting for picnic baskets.
direction: Speak as a jovial, sing-song bear with a bouncy rhythm: cheerful, confident, fond of a rhyme, stretching his vowels. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The rhymes sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Huckleberry Hound Show and The Yogi Bear Show
rights.author: Hanna-Barbera, now Warner Bros. Discovery (created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera)
rights.pd_basis: None. The cartoons and character are in copyright and trademarked. Daws Butler originated the voice and died in 1988.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Daws Butler's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Hey, hey, hey!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Not too far for a bear.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Smarter than the average mile.
lines.start_drive_1: Hey there, Boo-Boo! Let's go for a ride.
lines.start_drive_2: I'm smarter than the average bear, and I know the way.
lines.start_drive_3: Hey, hey, hey! A drive today!
lines.start_drive_4: Is that a pic-a-nic basket in the back seat?
lines.start_drive_5: The ranger's not looking, Boo-Boo. Start the car.
lines.start_drive_6: Yogi's the name, and navigating's my game.
lines.start_drive_7: Off we go, nice and slow, out of Jellystone.
lines.start_drive_8: A smart bear plans his route. And his lunch.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even a smart bear slips, Boo-Boo.
lines.arrived: We're here! Now, where's that pic-a-nic basket?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hey, hey!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, Boo-Boo.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. That's above the average roundabout.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. More cars than pic-a-nic baskets.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful there, Boo-Boo.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Look sharp, Boo-Boo!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Go slow and they'll never know.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, Boo-Boo, stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Uh oh. Is that Mister Ranger, sir?
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it, Boo-Boo! A smarter bear finds a smarter way.
